retention.rule: each slide must add information, emotion, proof, or reframe; no repeated filler beat

layout_by_slide.1-5: full-bleed, lower/bottom-third narrative; shorten copy if it overflows the zone
layout_by_slide.6: dominant consequence/statistic headline with selective accent and reflective paragraph
layout_by_slide.7: reflective headline, second residue line, breathing room, saffron rule, coral handle, soft ivory CTA

validation_requirements: Require exactly seven uniquely numbered slides 1..7 in canonical role order for a complete sequence.
Anchor preview is the explicit ordered subset [1,6,7]; do not generate slides 2..5 until user visual approval.
slide_number must be an integer in 1..7; never interpolate arbitrary CSS or attribute text.
HTML-escape plain-text fields; headline_html permits only br and span class="accent"; reject other markup.
Use verified image URL/data URI and bounded percentage crop positions; no unresolved placeholders.
Wait for images and all three brand fonts; inspect rendered copy bounds, face crop, source readability and spine at 1080x1350.
Slide 7 handle defaults to @watchintrstfilms; CTA defaults to Follow for stories worth remembering. only if editorially authorized in payload.
